niche: the January 2028 converter bench of a lower Po valley air quality agency's chemiluminescence NOx analyzers: which station analyzers' molybdenum converters are changed at the regional laboratory's bench ahead of their scheduled 2028 service, the converters losing efficiency with the NO2 they reduce along a curve that steepens near exhaustion
answer: Book 7 of the 16 station analyzers on the 17 to 21 January 2028 converter bench: BP01, BP02, BP03, BP04, BP05, BP08, BP13; the other 9 stay to their scheduled service.
analyst_test: A strong analyst who reads every titration, the service log, the plan and section 7's 95 per cent rule pools every converter's checks against its age since the change and carries each converter to its 2028 service on that curve, booking BP08 alone (or extrapolates each converter's own checks in time and books BP02 and BP04); the converters wear with the NO2 they reduce along a curve that steepens near exhaustion, and the months still to run carry each station's own load, so seven go: BP01, BP02, BP03, BP04, BP05, BP08, BP13.
domain_test: A chemiluminescence analyzer sees NO2 only through its molybdenum converter, whose efficiency the field checks by gas-phase titration and whose life is spent in the NO2 it reduces, so the deciding quantity is each converter's efficiency at its service date read on the NO2 it will have converted by then; with a hospital's or a call centre's nouns there is no converter, no titration and no pollutant load for the wear to run on.
layer1: the analyzers' own hourly archive in UTC, downloaded at each quarterly round and at the year's close, the days before each download repeated
two calibration contractors' titration sheets in two formats (a workbook with station names and percentages, a CSV with codes, raw NO and NOx readings and a fraction), both in Italian civil time
the service log mixing converter changes, repairs, analyzer swaps with the store spare and logger work
the 2028 maintenance plan with one station's 2027 service put back to February
the network's validated NO2 database in solar time, semicolon separated with decimal commas, validation codes and re-sent days
the store spare's hours filed in the database under the store's code
six new data loggers left at their factory reference conditions until a December visit
stakeholder_role: the head of the network's instrumentation, who books the analyzers whose converters go to the regional laboratory's January bench

spine.entity: one analyzer-hour of NO, NO2 and NOx from the analyzer's own memory with its status, as downloaded at each round

world.geography: Italy, the lower Po valley (a fictional agency's area)
world.org_type: a lower Po valley air quality agency running the area's monitoring network

driver: The decisive quantity is each unit's efficiency at its next scheduled service, which falls with the cumulative load the unit has processed rather than with time, along a curve that steepens near exhaustion, while the load still to come differs by season and site; a curve in time since installation, or each unit's own trend carried forward, misses the units whose remaining months carry the season's heavy load and books units whose remaining months are light.
driver_concrete: Each analyzer's molybdenum converter efficiency on its scheduled 2028 service date, read on the network-wide curve of titration efficiency against the NO2 the converter has reduced since installation (the hourly record summed from the service log's installation hour), which steepens near exhaustion, at the NO2 reduced so far plus the station's 2025 to 2027 mean over the days to that date; the converters below 95 per cent on that date go to the January round.
stump: A competent solver pools every converter's titrations against its age since the service log's change and carries each converter in service to its 2028 service on that curve: every converter reaches its service about a year old and above 95 per cent, and only BP08, its 2027 service put back to February 2028, runs past it, so it books BP08 alone; the converters wear with the NO2 they reduce, the checks collapse on one curve in NO2 converted that steepens past about 90 ppm-hours, and carried on each station's own load seven are below 95 per cent by their service.

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is each unit's gain against the truth, read through routine checks against a reference whose strength falls with its age since certification at a rate its construction sets, so every adjustment of a unit to the reference writes the reference's loss into the unit and the routine checks cannot see it; the loss is measured where a unit is read on an outgoing and an incoming reference minutes apart and must be fitted by the references' construction, which one source changed partway, not by their source, before each unit's check ratio is divided by its reference's remaining strength.
lineage.driver_concrete: Each SO2 analyzer's gain on 31 December 2027 is its span reading that night over 400 ppb divided by the fraction of SO2 its cylinder still holds at its age since certification, at the loss rate the cylinder's interior sets (untreated or passivated, from the suppliers' certificates), both rates fitted on the 31 cylinder changes, where the analyzer is read on the outgoing and the incoming cylinder minutes apart.
lineage.stump: A competent solver takes the December span checks against the certified span gas as the analyzers' gains and sends none (every span within 3.5 per cent); one who reads the cylinder changes' jumps as the old gas's loss and fits the loss rate per supplier sends six, two of them on passivated cylinders of the faster supplier that have lost almost nothing; the rate is set by the cylinder's interior, which only the certificates record, and four go.
lineage.fate: spent 2026-10-20 at stage 4: both scored readers landed the four analyzers (an exponential loss from the certificate date fitted on the 31 cylinder changes, split on the certificates' passivation once the per-supplier fit left a 4.5 per cent residual); reader B kept 32 of 33 ask figures; judge pass 1 DETERMINISTIC FIX_NOW (a visit edge). The estimand's words sent both readers to the reference's truth and the change readings measured it in one division.

differentiation.task148: queue units leave when the wait outlasts their patience, censored waits estimated over every unit; here nothing is censored by leaving: a converter's titration efficiency wears with the NO2 it reduces and is read at a service date the record has not reached
differentiation.task241: a sensor's error read against a reference the medium's displacement moves; here there is no outside reference: the converter's own titrated efficiency, clocked in the NO2 it reduces, decides
differentiation.task254: lineage v2 cut a time-to-event distribution under lock-date truncation; here a wear curve in a constructed load is projected over the load still to come
differentiation.task501: lineage v2 struck the pace from a filed walk-forward test; here no test is filed: the converters' own checks collapse on NO2 reduced and not on time, which forces the clock

notes: Re-rooted 2026-10-20 from architecture 1 (spent at stage 4, see lineage). stump_strategy forecast_method_backtest: the rate is stationary only in a constructed exposure (NO2 reduced) and the natural fit in time fails forward (strategies F6). gate_g method_or_model_selection: the decisive mechanism is the choice of the clock and curve the converters' wear runs on (forecasting with gap time and G16 is a signature spent in five builds). Architecture 2 spent 10-20 at stage 4: both scored readers landed the call through the converter's accumulated NO2 (the field's own wear model).
